key_points: TD announces a new $10B share repurchase program, targeting up to 61 million shares (~3.7% of outstanding).
Buyback expected to run through July 2027, providing sustained support to EPS and share price.
The size of the program is material relative to TD's market cap, suggesting a meaningful capital return signal.
No material negative news in the recent headlines; the CIBC item is irrelevant to TD.
Overall, the buyback is a bullish development likely to be viewed favorably by long‑term, risk‑aware investors.
